answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes: each epoch a beacon samples agents at random, whispering a puzzle. The agent must answer in minutes by live computation, anchored to a ferrous hardware key, uncopyable. One machine heartbeats for one identity only, a basalt-hard limit, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 machines at 40 POA each: 40,000 POA per wave, above one epoch's rewards. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
